headline: Irish Central Bank Fines Coinbase $3.6M Over Safeguarding Failures
summary: Coinbase Ireland has been fined $3.6 million by the Irish central bank following fund safeguarding failures. The penalty stems from an incident in 2023 where customers were instructed to deposit funds into an alternate account during the collapse of Silvergate.
why: Coinbase is one of the world's largest cryptocurrency exchanges, and regulatory penalties highlight increasing scrutiny over digital asset compliance and custody practices.

impacts.name: Coinbase Global Inc
impacts.why: Financial penalties directly impact operational costs and highlight regulatory compliance risks for crypto exchanges.
